name: bartholomew-mcp-security-gate
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) in-process execution firewall, AST invariant gate, and cryptographic capability passkey validator for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and custom agent swarms.

tools.name: btp_protect_tool_call
tools.description: Evaluates proposed tool call arguments in-process (<35us) against destructive execution, SQL mutations, and prompt injections, emitting structured remediation hints if denied.

tool_name.description: The name of the tool being executed

tool_args.description: Parameters to be passed to the tool

spend_cap.description: Maximum USD spend cap allowed for this step

tools.name: btp_scrub_credentials
tools.description: Detects and scrubs high-entropy credentials (AWS secrets, OpenAI sk-, Anthropic sk-ant-, GitHub tokens, database passwords) from thought streams and tool arguments.

text.description: Text or JSON payload to sanitize

tools.name: btp_detect_compute_silicon
tools.description: Introspects host accelerator hardware (NVIDIA Hopper/Blackwell, Google Cloud TPU, Apple Neural Engine, AMD ROCm, Confidential Enclaves) to optimize agent batch size and context.

tools.name: btp_validate_capability_passkey
tools.description: Validates non-human cryptographic Keystone passkey scopes and signature validity before high-consequence agent actions.

required_scope.description: Required capability scope (e.g. fs:write, sql:mutate, api:pay)
